title: formatter ignores `fmt: off` pragma inside match expression
body:
### Summary

https://play.ruff.rs/764d5d6b-56ff-495d-af08-bad7336b0272

```python
match left, right:
    # fmt: off
    case None, None: pass
    case None, y   : pass
    case x,    None: pass
    case x,    y   : pass
    # fmt: on
```

gets formatted to

```python
match left, right:
    # fmt: off
    case None, None:
        pass
    case None, y:
        pass
    case x, None:
        pass
    case x, y:
        pass
    # fmt: on
```

despite the `fmt: off` pragma
